description: A drum machine where every hit has a shape. Eight voices on 16 steps draw the rhythm as a picture, on the device and on a big screen.

controls.action: Start the preset beat; press again to stop.
Next pattern, A–D, and its picture. While playing, it switches at the end of the bar.
Cycle the step for the selected voice: on, accent, off.
Swing: Off, Light, Medium, Heavy. Off-beat shapes move later with their sound.
Select a voice. Its shapes stand out.
Mute or unmute the selected voice. A muted voice leaves the picture.
Tune the selected voice. Higher pitch, higher shape.
Decay of the selected voice. A longer sound keeps its shape longer.
Open Menu for Guide, audio, Reload or Exit.
Play the selected voice once, playing or stopped.
Cycle on, accent, off. Each pad sits under its step in the picture.
Select it. It lights when it plays.

sections.title: Shapes
sections.text: Disc: bass drum. Bar: snare. Ticks along the bottom: closed hat. Ring: open hat. Squares: clap. Triangle: low tom. Slash: rim shot. Two rectangles: cowbell. Time runs left to right; an accent is larger and brighter.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: Patterns, tempo, swing, mutes, tune, decay and colors save automatically. Reopening keeps them and starts stopped.
